title: TacHair: Tactile Contact-Distribution Guided Online Correction for Robotic Hair Stroking and Perception
description:
arXiv:2610.10637v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Hair stroking is common in daily grooming and personal care, and is also widely used in hair-product evaluation, motivating robots with similar physical interaction capabilities.
